mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.title, a.content, a.cover_url, a.summary, a.author, a.author_id, a.author_admin_id, a.view_count, a.is_pinned, a.created_at, a.updated_at, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(u.avatar_url), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(au.avatar_url), '')) AS author_avatar_url FROM articles a LEFT JOIN users u ON a.author_id = u.id LEFT JOIN admin_users au ON a.author_admin_id = au.id ORDER BY a.is_pinned DESC, a.created_at DESC

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.content, a.cover_url, a.summary, a.author, a.author_id, a.author_admin_id, a.view_count, a.is_pinned, a.created_at, a.updated_at, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(u.avatar_url), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(au.avatar_url), '')) AS author_avatar_url FROM articles a LEFT JOIN users u ON a.author_id = u.id LEFT JOIN admin_users au ON a.author_admin_id = au.id WHERE a.id = #{id}

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.content, a.cover_url, a.summary, a.author, a.author_id, a.author_admin_id, a.view_count, a.is_pinned, a.created_at, a.updated_at, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(u.avatar_url), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(au.avatar_url), '')) AS author_avatar_url FROM articles a LEFT JOIN users u ON a.author_id = u.id LEFT JOIN admin_users au ON a.author_admin_id = au.id WHERE a.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.author LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.summary LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY a.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO articles (title, content, cover_url, summary, author, author_id, author_admin_id, view_count, is_pinned, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{coverUrl}, #{summary}, #{author}, #{authorId}, #{authorAdminId}, #{viewCount}, #{isPinned}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE articles SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, cover_url = #{coverUrl}, summary = #{summary}, author = #{author}, view_count = #{viewCount}, is_pinned = #{isPinned}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE articles SET view_count = IFNULL(view_count, 0) + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE articles SET is_pinned = #{pinned} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.title, a.content, a.cover_url, a.summary, a.author, a.author_id, a.author_admin_id, a.view_count, a.is_pinned, a.created_at, a.updated_at, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(u.avatar_url), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(au.avatar_url), '')) AS author_avatar_url FROM articles a LEFT JOIN users u ON a.author_id = u.id LEFT JOIN admin_users au ON a.author_admin_id = au.id WHERE a.author_id = #{authorId} ORDER BY a.created_at DESC
